---
title: Data Types
sidebar_label: Overview
---

> A library for defining the data structures and mapping, exports to Opensearch Mappings, GraphQL, xLucene, and more.

## Installation

```bash
# Using pnpm
pnpm add @terascope/data-types
# Using npm
npm install --save @terascope/data-types
```
